sources.title: Maine Income Tax Withholding Tables for Individual Income Tax — 2026

methods: Employee-requested flat amount or fixed percentage
calculationSteps: Annualize gross pay using the payroll-frequency multiplier.
Compute the filing-status standard deduction, including its annual-wage phaseout.
Subtract allowance and standard deductions from annual wages; clamp taxable annual income at zero.
Apply the filing-status annual withholding schedule.
Divide annual withholding by payroll frequency and round to the nearest whole dollar.

rounding.midpointRule: Not stated explicitly; requires reviewer decision and boundary tests before activation.

supplementalWages.combinedWithRegularWages: Treat as one payment for the regular payroll period.

specialRules: If a Form W-4ME is missing or invalid, withhold as single with zero allowances.
A nonresident employee ordinarily becomes subject to withholding after working more than 12 days in Maine and earning more than $3,000 during the year.
Income earned on Maine tribal land by qualifying enrolled tribal members residing on tribal land is not subject to Maine income tax withholding.
Backup withholding and specified non-wage payments use a flat 5%; qualifying gambling winnings use 7.15%.
Additional employee-requested withholding is added after the calculated amount.

officialExamples.name: Single weekly below zero taxable income
